origin.mirroredorigin.mirrored.name: The Mirrored
origin.mirroredorigin.mirrored.descripti: You exist on the far side of the reflection, in a world repeated down to the last stone and empty of everything that walks. Reality rejects you, and you can bear it only moments at a time. Nothing in the mirror will ever come looking for you.
power.mirroredorigin.glass_body.name: Dead Reflection
power.mirroredorigin.glass_body.descript: You have only 7 hearts, and you are undead — a reflection was never alive to begin with.
power.mirroredorigin.water_phobia.name: Hydrophobia
power.mirroredorigin.water_phobia.descri: Water severs your tie to the Normal World. Any contact throws you straight back into the Mirror World, and while you are in it your active powers will not work.
power.mirroredorigin.reality_toxicity.de: The Normal World poisons you. After 10 seconds there you are struck by Slowness and Weakness, after 20 seconds you begin taking damage, and after 25 seconds you die.
power.mirroredorigin.phase_shift.name: Phase Shift
power.mirroredorigin.phase_shift.descrip: [Primary Active] Switches your phase. Returning to the Mirror World is free; leaving for the Normal World costs 6 hunger and all saturation. Cooldown: 6 seconds.
power.mirroredorigin.banishment_punch.de: [Secondary Active] Charges your fist for 3 seconds. Striking a creature with your bare hand during that time banishes it to the opposite phase. Cooldown: 10 minutes on a hit, 5 minutes on a miss.
power.mirroredorigin.spawn_in_mirror.des: You are born and reborn in the Mirror World.
power.mirroredorigin.glass_skin.name: Glass Skin
power.mirroredorigin.glass_skin.descript: Your skin takes on a translucent, glassy hue.
